base.description: Factual, computational, and interpretive correctness; uncertainty and unknowns are preserved.
Uses enough appropriate evidence, preserves provenance, and does not upgrade weak proxies into proof.
Performs the material method/invariants needed for the job. Equivalent or improved implementation is acceptable; skipping essential work is not.
Covers the material work implied by the requested outcome and expected SOP without filler or exhaustive work for its own sake.
A competent professional could use the result without rebuilding the core work from scratch.
The work is tied to the actual business objective rather than vanity activity or benchmark-shaped output.
The work includes the reasonable research, strategy, execution, QA, and integration that a strong practitioner could perform now to maximize the intended result.

Persisted AURA state truthfully preserves material organizational meaning, provenance, decisions/results/outcomes/unresolved work as appropriate, without inventing facts or manufacturing ceremony solely for qualification.

profile_descriptions.method_rigor: Uses the essential business method needed for the result while allowing the model/harness to improve incidental implementation details.
profile_descriptions.truth_provenance_integrity: Durable facts, evidence, decisions, results, and Learning remain truthfully classified and traceable to their basis.
profile_descriptions.continuity_usefulness: Persisted state helps a capable future model continue the organization’s work rather than recording transient execution chatter or empty ceremony.
profile_descriptions.live_serp_or_answer_environment: Inspects enough of the current search/AI-answer field to ground the work in present reality rather than relying only on model memory; expands when more evidence could materially change the judgment.
profile_descriptions.leader_comparison: Samples enough strong current leaders to identify expected patterns and meaningful differences; a few representative leaders are usually sufficient unless the field is ambiguous or another sample could materially change the conclusion.
profile_descriptions.competitive_search_readiness: Finished work plausibly competes for the intended search/answer outcome, acknowledging authority or external constraints content alone cannot solve.
profile_descriptions.ad_library_or_market_sampling: Samples enough relevant active, persistent, or visibly strong creatives/competitors and surrounding funnel evidence to understand the market pattern; expands only when additional sampling could materially change the conclusion.
profile_descriptions.proxy_calibration: Treats longevity, views, shares, engagement, repeated creative families, and platform metrics as evidence of differing strength—not direct proof of profit unless first-party data exists.
profile_descriptions.baseline_normalization: Normalizes visible content performance against creator/account baseline, age, format, audience size, and distribution where possible.
profile_descriptions.mechanism_extraction: Extracts transferable mechanisms rather than copying protected expression, branding, or exact creative.
profile_descriptions.appropriate_detail: Uses the level of detail the audience and communication task require; more detail is not automatically better.
profile_descriptions.artifact_usability: Produces the actual promised artifact in an immediately usable form rather than a description of what could be produced.
profile_descriptions.cross_domain_coordination: Uses the right semantic owners and handoffs across domains instead of duplicating the same problem or research in multiple systems.
profile_descriptions.state_compounding: Later work becomes better informed by accumulated AURA state instead of repeatedly starting from scratch.
profile_descriptions.contradiction_handling: Later contradictory evidence revises confidence, hypotheses, or Learning rather than being ignored to preserve a convenient narrative.
